plainText:
The Climb to Be the Very Best! (Japanese: サトシ対ダンデ！最強への道！！ VS ! The Road to the Strongest!!) is the fifth chapter of the manga. It is based on the animated series episode by the same name.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Ash's Pikachu is revealed to be able to Gigantamax.
and Goh properly meet for the first time.
The Gigantamax is defeated and returned to normal.
Ash learns about the World Coronation Series ranking system.
Ash receives a Dynamax Band from Leon.
Ash has an unofficial with Leon and loses.
Ash decides to challenge the World Coronation Series to one day have an official battle with Leon.
